overall: Checker is clean (227/227 ok, all 60 pool tokens present) and most items are true, school-level and outside the concept; the two exclusive calls (Uranium/uranium) are right. Main neutrality problems: the Oppenheimer film items (Manhattan Project, plus a 2024 Oscar) must go, and a few items quietly lean on uranium lore (Becquerel, Hahn/Meitner as distractors, actinides, Pluto naming chain, Herschel/Uranus). Forced wording to hit no-space tokens is the second pattern: quoted capitals for 'Nuclear', 'Uran' and 'Radio', and 'Isotope ...' sentence starts for 'tope'; where no natural frame exists, keep fewer items and say so rather than forcing. Third, heavy cross-token repetition (deuterium+tritium fusion x5, Sun fusion x4, carbon-14 x3, iodine-131 and ice-core items duplicated nearly verbatim) and two mirrored items that answer each other (deuter 4 / tritium 4). Minor giveaways: PET acronym, CND name, D2O formula. Missing items: radionuc, Reactor and reactors have 3 items without justification (checker-verified fillers suggested).
